summary: Defined scheduler, quota, backpressure and autonomous action-budget rules for AgentOS so Agent Runtime can operate the OS without unbounded retries, unsafe replanning or hidden host fallback.
acceptance_evidence: runtime-scheduler-budget.md defines sequential-first scheduling, durable dependency truth, risk-class budget policy, autonomous action budgets, quotas, backpressure and operator escalation states.
High-risk and mutating actions are constrained to a single mutating lane and must still pass approval, policy and SecurityExecutionEngine before any side effect.
Retry exhaustion is specified to produce Suspended, RollbackPending or FailedClosed states rather than indefinite autonomous retry.
Observation-triggered replanning consumes a replan budget, preserves trust labels and cannot reset retry budget or turn untrusted content into operator intent.
Sandbox resource denials are treated as backpressure or failure evidence and cannot fall back to host execution.
